note: BH-7491. The most time bin/fly-pool-tick.sh waits for its project ticks before it runs the BH-2522 preflight and exits. A tick still running at the bound keeps its own project lock, so the next cron start ticks the other projects. Keep it under the 600 s cron cadence. Settings row `lane.fly-pool-tick.pool_tick_wait_s`. 0 means no bound: wait for every project tick (the pre-BH-7491 contract).
